outcome: specific types of malformations in live births
cohort: Data were collected from couples who underwent conventional IVF or ICSI fresh transfer cycles at the Center for Reproductive Medicine of Peking University Third Hospital in China between January 2009 and December 2019.
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the rates of congenital malformations between offspring from conventional IVF and ICSI, nor in specific malformations, pregnancy outcomes, malformations among miscarriages, or birth weight.
